```{r}
#| label: results-setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
find_data_dir <- function() {
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(getwd(), "data", "output"),
    file.path(getwd(), "..", "data", "output"),
    file.path(dirname(getwd()), "..", "data", "output")
  )
  for (cand in candidates) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(cand, "stage7_model.csv"))) {
      return(normalizePath(cand))
    }
  }
  stop("data/output not found - run `pixi run cumulative-blocks` first")
}
data_dir <- find_data_dir()
m <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "stage7_model.csv"))
a <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "stage7_agent.csv"))
init <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "stage7_initial.csv"))
stats <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "stage7_results_stats.csv"))

stat_row <- function(level, metric) stats[stats$level == level & stats$metric == metric, ]
pop <- function(metric) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", stat_row("population", metric)$mean, stat_row("population", metric)$sd)
pop_cv <- function(metric) sprintf("%.1f%%", stat_row("population", metric)$cv)
pop_range <- function(metric) sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", stat_row("population", metric)$min, stat_row("population", metric)$max)
agent <- function(metric) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", stat_row("agent_step", metric)$mean, stat_row("agent_step", metric)$sd)
agent_cv <- function(metric) sprintf("%.1f%%", stat_row("agent_step", metric)$cv)
corr_val <- function(metric) sprintf("%.2f", stat_row("correlation", metric)$mean)
model_interp <- function(metric) stat_row("population", metric)$interpretation
agent_interp <- function(metric) stat_row("agent_step", metric)$interpretation
baseline_max_corr <- function() {
  vars <- c("pss10", "resilience", "affect", "current_stress")
  pairs <- combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  rs <- sapply(pairs, function(p) cor(init[[p[1]]], init[[p[2]]]))
  sprintf("%.2f", max(abs(rs)))
}
baseline_corr <- function(x, y) sprintf("%.2f", cor(init[[x]], init[[y]]))
final_corr <- function(x, y) {
  f <- a[a$Step == max(a$Step), ]
  sprintf("%.2f", cor(f[[x]], f[[y]]))
}
```
